claims: "Pensión" in Spanish refers to a retirement pension or a guesthouse/boarding house.
A retirement pension is a fund where money is accumulated during working years to provide income during retirement.
A retirement pension [consists of] regular payments to a person after retirement.
Pension types include defined benefit plans and defined contribution plans.
Defined benefit [plans provide] guaranteed lifetime income.
In Spain's Social Security, applications should be submitted within 3 months before or after employment termination.
A pensión (as lodging) is a type of guesthouse or boarding house common in Europe, North Africa, and parts of Latin America.
"Full pension" [is] full board: breakfast, lunch, and dinner.
"Half pension" [is] half board: breakfast and one other meal.
In some regions, "pensión de estacionamiento" [refers to] a monthly parking service.
"Pensión" can refer to alimony or child support (pensión alimenticia).
The IRS indicates that tax may be withheld from periodic payments unless a form is filed.
